raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Starting with batch 12, the source appears to have relabeled posted transactions from status 'POSTED' to 'SETTLED'. The silver filter only keeps 'POSTED', so it drops every non-reversed row in batches 12-14. The counts back this up: batches 1-11 hold 3652 POSTED and 180 REVERSED rows, and batches 12-14 hold 978 SETTLED and 56 REVERSED, so the reversal rate is about the same before and after. Nothing in the change notes mentions this rename, so the source team should still confirm it.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.6, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status IN ('POSTED', 'SETTLED')"}}
